bhaṇḍeti:

(chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ ~anti … na sakkā imehi saha ~itun ti); S I 162,.17 (abhaṇḍante ~asi); Th 933 (aññamaññehi ~are; Th-a III 78,.15 : kalahaṃ karonti); 943 (saṅghalābhassa ~anti; Th-a III 80,.7 : saṅghalābhahetu ~anti); Sadd 356,.12 (bhaḍi paribhāsane: ~ati bhaṇḍanaṃ); — part.pr. bhaṇḍanta, mfn., Vin IV 4,.30 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ ~antā pesale bhikkhū omasanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~entā); S I 162,.20 (~antaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati) ≠ A II 152,.16 (Mp III 386,.28 : ~antan ti paharantaṃ); Pj II 357,.18 (aññamaññaṃ ~antā); — neg. abhaṇḍanta, mfn., S I 162,.17; — absol. bhaṇḍitvā, Vin IV 227,.23 (bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ~itvā gāmakaṃ ñātikulaṃ agamāsi); Ja I 239,.10 (so māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ~itvā); Vism 20,.32 (kulasuṇhā sāmikena saddhiṃ ~itvā); — fpp bhaṇḍitabba, mfn., Cp-a 313,.14 (paro na hiṃsitabbo na ~itabbo, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee khaṇḍitabbo).
duddhara:

kadamba:

kāsati:

paṭijīva:

poṇa:

3poṇa

pāṭipadika:

āhariya:

[S., BHS dharma], dhamma denotes (an interpretation of) the essential nature and reality of existence and experience, the way things are: it is descriptive and prescriptive; it denotes also an essential attribute of men or animals; a quality or characteristic; Abh 784 (~o sabhāve pariyattipaññāñāyesu saccappakatīsu puññe ñeyye guṇācārasamādhisū pi nissattatāpattisu kāraṇādo); see also Sv 99,.3 foll., Ps I 17,.16 foll., It-a I 37,.20 foll., Paṭis-a 18,.1 foll., Bv-a 13,.4 foll., As 38,.23 foll. and Sadd 560,.25 foll.; — for Buddhists dhamma is used to denote an interlocking and interdependent assembly of concepts: the true nature of the world of experience, how that world works, and the way to transcend it, as understood by the Buddha; the progressive stages of understanding and nibbāna ; the behaviour, the practice, required to achieve understanding of the way the world of experience works, ie the way to reach arhatship, nibbāna ; the understanding and practice taught by the Buddha, the substance of his teaching, the texts of the Canon, especially the Suttapiṭaka ; all constituents of the world of experience, physical and mental, external and internal, progressively more and more minutely analysed; all constituents of prescribed practice, appropriate and beneficial actions; prescriptions for the members of the saṅgha ; — for people generally dhamma is an interpretation of the essential nature of existence and experience; the way one should act, depending on who one is, to maintain the way things are and should be; duty; right; justice; normative and beneficial actions; — 1. (i) how the world of experience works, the processes by which it works and is explained (especially as formulated in cattāri ariyasaccāni and paṭiccasamuppāda ), and the possibility and way of transcending it, as understood by the Buddha and taught by him (so that knowledge and understanding of it might bring enlightenment, arhatship, to others); Vin I 2,3* (yadā have pātubhavanti ~ā ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa ath’ assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā yato pajānāti sahetudhammaṃ; Sp 954,.19 foll. : pātubhavantī ti uppajjanti ~ā ti anulomapaccayākārapaṭivedhasādhakā bodhipakkhiyadhammā, atha vā pātubhavantī ti pakāsenti abhisamayavasena vyattā pākaṭā honti, ~ā ti caturāriyasaccadhammā); 11,.2 (idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu ~esu cakkhuṃ udapādi); 12,.24 (ehi bhikkhū ti bhagavā avoca svākkhāto ~o cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā ti); 15,.31 (idaṃ kho Yasa anupaddutaṃ idaṃ anupassaṭṭhaṃ ehi Yasa nisīda ~aṃ te desessāmī ti); 40,.19 foll. pr. 3 sg. [caus. of *ud + vamati; cf S. udvamati], makes suck back; Ps II 279,.6 (cheko ahituṇḍiko sappassa daṭṭhavisaṃ ten’ eva sappena puna ḍasāpetvā ~eyya, Ce, Ee so; Be ubbāheyya; Se ubbāteyya).
ukkaṇṭhāpayati:
ukkaṇṭhati
pr. 3 sg. [S. utkaṇṭhate, BHS utkaṇṭhati], yearns (for); sorrows over; frets; loses heart; is discontented (with, instr. or loc.), is unhappy (esp. of a bhikkhu , longing to return to a secular life); Th 718 (~āmi sarīrena); Ja I 450,30´ (paṇḍito attano vattapūraṇādike kammamhi vāyameth’ eva na ~eyya); VI 173,.21 (kiṃ brāhmaṇa ~asī ti); Ap 467,.5 (sugatena vinā bhūto ~āmi muhuttakaṃ); Sp 986,.9 (daharā mā ~antu); Ps I 295,.14 (abhiramati … buddhasāsane na ~atī ti); Spk II 98,.8 (nibbindeyyā ti ~eyya); Pv-a 162,.1 (mā ~asī ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr mā khuṇḍalī); As 194,.23 (paccantasenāsanesu ca adhikusaladhammesu ca ~issatī ti aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ, so read with Be, Ce, Se); — part.pr. (a) ukkaṇṭhanta, mfn., Vism 651,.15 (imassa kulaputtassa nibbindantassa ~antassa anabhiramantassa); — neg. anukkaṇṭhanta, mfn., Ja V 10,.27; VI 289,.21 (an-ukkaṇṭhanto idha vasāhī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee anukkaṇṭhacitto; Se mā ukkaṇṭhito); (b) ukkaṇṭhamāna, mfn., As 407,.32; — neg. anukkaṇṭhamāna, mfn., Ja I 141,.8; Sp 1060,.33; — aor. 3 sg. ukkaṇṭhi, Ja I 367,.26 (ekaṃ alaṅkata-itthiṃ disvā ~i); 3 pl. ukkaṇṭhiṃsu, Spk I 70,.31; — absol. ukkaṇṭhitvā, Ja III 143,.17 (Kesavo Kappena vinā vasanto ~itvā); Vism 705,.6; Dhp-a I 118,.5 (āyasmā Nando ~itvā); — neg. anukkaṇṭhitvā, Spk I 286,.15; —     pp     ukkaṇṭhita,   mfn. and n. [S. utkaṇṭhita], fretting; discontented; discontent, unhappiness; Vin I 253,.10 (te ~-rūpā vassaṃ vasiṃsu); Th 105 (~o pi na vase); Ja VI 27,.5 (gharāvāse ~o pabbajitukāmo hutvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ukkhaṇṭhito); Cp 3:3:8 (~o ’mhi kāyena rajjenamhi anatthiko); Mil 286,.3 (so pakatiyā va ~o tassā devatāya vacanena … ubbiji); Sp 217,.1 (~o gihībhāvaṃ patthayamāno); 247,.6 (~o ti anabhiratiyā imasmiṃ sāsane kicchajīvikaṃ patto); Ps I 283,.24 (arati nāma ~-tā); III 332,.2 (dubbhojanena ca dukkhaseyyāya ca ~o hoti); Dhp-a IV 225,.19 (araññavāse ~-ttaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ukkaṇṭhiṃ); Mhv 66:56 (tass’ ~-velāyaṃ); — neg. anukkaṇṭhita, mfn., not fretting; content; Ja III 58,5´; Pv-a 13,.29; —      caus. 3 sg.     ukkaṇṭhāpeti,           ~ayati,   makes discontented, unsettles; Ja II 115,.20 (ko pana taṃ ~etī ti); — aor. 3 sg. ukkaṇṭhāpesi, Ja I 303,.13; 3 pl. ukkaṇṭhāpayiṃsu, Ja VI 148,23´ (mama putte na ramāpayiṃsu ~ayiṃsu); — pp ukkaṇṭhāpita, mfn., made discontented; Ja III 248,.21 (kena ~ito sī ti); Sp 566,.19; Dhp-a II 259,.12 (~itattā).
ummūlakavāta:
ummūlaka
mfn. [ummūla + ka2], uprooting; —      °-vāta,   m., a wind which uproots; Ja I 303,.21 (mahājambu-ummūlakavāto).
upacaritabba:
upacarati
pr. 3 sg. [S. upacarati], approaches; serves, attends; treats carefully, honours; uses figuratively; Vin IV 183,.22 (corā vattabbā manussā idh’ ~anti apasakkathā ti); — inf. upacarituṃ, Ja VI 180,15´ (yo imaṃ selaṃ suṭṭhu ~ituṃ accituṃ … jānāti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se upadhārituṃ); —     pp (a) upacarita,   mfn. [ts], 1. approached, attended upon; performed; followed; Abh 751 (~o tu upāsito); Mil 360,.2 (imehi terasahi dhutaguṇehi … ciṇṇehi pariciṇṇehi caritehi ~ehi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se upadhāritehi); It-a II 5,.29 (yathā pubbāparaṃ sapaṃsuke padese ~-maggavasena piṭṭhipāsāṇe migena gatamaggo evaṃ iṭṭhāniṭṭhārammaṇesu sukhadukkhānubhavanena pi majjhattārammaṇānubhavana-bhāvena viññāyati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee upariharita-); — 2. used figuratively; Sadd 389,.32 (°-vasenā ti daṭṭhabbaṃ);  (b) upaciṇṇa,   mfn. [S. upacīrṇa], treated; attended upon; — durupaciṇṇa, durūpaciṇṇa, mfn., wrongly treated; wrongly attended to; Sp 312,.24 (yaṃ kadalinālikera-ādīnaṃ tattha jātakaphalāni āmasantassa dukkaṭaṃ vuttaṃ idaṃ durupaciṇṇadukkaṭaṃ nāma, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee durūpaciṇṇa-); 851,.32 foll.; — sūpaciṇṇa, supacinṇa, mfn., well or properly treated, honoured; Ja VI 180,9* (sūpaciṇṇo ayaṃ selo accito mahito sadā sudhārito sunikkhitto sabbatthaṃ abhisādhaye, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se supaciṇṇo); —      fpp     upacaritabba,   mfn., Sp 1365,.17 (yo bhikkhu uju sīlavā kāyavaṅkādirahito so maddaven’ eva ~o); Vibh-a 367,.30 (kasanavapanavasena manussehi ~aṃ vanantaṃ atikkamitvā); — neg. anupacaritabba, mfn., Nidd-a I 446,.15 (manussehi anupacaritabbe senāsane); —      caus. pp     upacārita,   mfn., expressed figuratively, expressed by an extension of meaning; Th-a II 219,.35 (nimittaṃ h’ ettha kattubhāvena ~aṃ yathā ariyabhāvakarāni saccāni ariyasaccānī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee uparacitaṃ yathā ariyabhāvakarānī ti ariyānī ti); Sadd 736,.6 (nissayavasenopacāritanissite).
upanayhanasīla:
upanayhana
n. (or mfn.) and ~ā, f. [from upanayhati], tying up, binding; nursing a grudge, resenting; Ja IV 436,11´ (bālūpasevano pūtimacchaṃ ~aṃ kusaggaṃ viya hoti, Ee so; Be, Se °-kusaggaṃ; Ce upanayha); Vibh 357,.12 (upanāho ~ā upanayhitattaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee upanahanā upanahitattaṃ, prob. wr; Se upanahanā upanāhitattaṃ) ≠ Pp 18,.20 (Be, Ce, Ee so; Se upanahanā upanāhitattam); —      °-sīla,   mfn., prone to resentment; habitually nursing a grudge; Th-a III 84,.22 (upanāhī ti … ~ā); —      anupanayhana,   n., not tying up; not nursing a grudge; Dhp-a I 44,.16 (iminā ~ena nirindhano viya jātavedo upasammatī ti); Th-a II 211,.34 (anupanāhī ti … kodhassa ~-sīlo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee anupanāyhana-); — see also upanandhana, upanāhana.
upasobhā:
upasobhā
f. [S. upaśobhā], brilliance, splendour; — ifc see vijjulatô-
uppaṭṭhāpayato:
uppaṭṭhāpayato
in Ee at M III 218,.30 is wr for upaṭṭhāpayato (Be, Ce, Se so).
ussaṅkī:
ussaṅki(n)
mfn. [from *ud + saṅkati; cf saṅki(n)], fearful, apprehensive; distrustful; Vin I 347,.16 (bhīto ubbiggo ~ī utrasto); II 190,.26 (addasāsuṃ … mahāmattā Ajātasattukumāraṃ divādivassa bhītaṃ ubbiggaṃ ~iṃ utrastaṃ); Ud 19,.29 (gopito santo bhīto ubbiggo ~ī utrasto vihāsiṃ); Sv 135,16; —     anussaṅki(n),   mfn., without apprehension; not fearful; Vin II 184,.21 (abhīto anubbiggo ~ī anutrasto … viharāmi) ≠ Ud 19,.31; Mhv 10:40.
āgamī:
āgami(n)
mfn. [from āgama], 1. [cf S. āgāmin], coming, approaching; next; —      °(ī)-māsa,   m., the next month; Th-a II 123,.27 (sīghaṃ taṃ kiccaṃ ananuyuñjitvā ~e pakkhesu vā karissāmī ti dandhayeyya, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Se āgamanamāse); — 2. [S. āgamin], (a word) with an inserted letter or syllable; Sadd 724,.11 ([chaṭṭhī] āgamiṭṭhānito ca: puthass’ āgamo, o avassā ti ca nidassanaṃ).
āmaṇḍalikā:
āmaṇḍalikā
āmaṇḍaliyā f. (or āmaṇḍalika, āmaṇḍaliya, n.) [cf maṇḍalikā and S. maṇḍalī√kṛ], a (rough) circle; a group; M I 225,.11 (gāvo majjhe Gaṅgāya nadiyā sote ~aṃ karitvā, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee āmaṇḍaliyaṃ; Ps II 265,.28 : ~aṃ karitvā ti maṇḍalikaṃ katvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee āmaṇḍaliyaṃ karitvā ti maṇḍalaṃ katvā).
āmaṇḍasāraka:
āmaṇḍa
m. and n. [S. lex. āmaṇḍa, m., “castor-oil plant”], 1. (m.) the castor-oil plant, Ricinus communis; Abh 566 (eraṇḍo tu ca ~o); Bv 19:20 (bodhi tassa bhagavato ~o ti pavuccati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se āmalako ti; Bv-a 235,.9 : ~o ti āmalakarukkho); Sadd 922,.24 (~o maṇḍo); — 2. (n.) the fruit of the āmaṇḍa plant; M III 101,.22 (puriso pañca ~āni hatthe karitvā); Ap 97,.12 (~aṃ … adāsiṃ); Ps IV 147,.8 (~an ti āmalakaṃ); —      °-sāraka,   m., a vessel made from an āmaṇḍa fruit; Sp 293,.13 (telabhājanesu visāṇe nāḷiyaṃ vā alābuke vā ~e vā; Sp-ṭ [Be] II 122,.1 : ~e ti āmalakehi katabhājane); Vin-vn 3072.
ārocayitar:
ārocayita(r)
m. [from āroceti], one who announces, tells; Sp 398,.17 (bhagavā patisallānaṃ anuyutto imaṃ pavattiṃ na jānāti koci ’ssa ~ā pi n’ atthi) = Spk III 268,.4; — see also āroceta(r).
āsāḷhapuṇṇamī:
āsāḷha
āsādha m. [S. āṣāḍha], the name of a month (June/July); Abh 75 (~o dvīsu ca); Sp 1068,.2 (sāvanamāsaṃ akatvā puna āsādham eva kattukāmo, Ee, Se so; Be āsāḷhīmāsam eva; not in Ce); Sv 868,.3 (~e Sineru-samīpena caranti); Sadd 583,.18 (… jeṭṭho ~o sāvano …); —      °-puṇṇamā,   °-puṇṇamī,   f., the full-moon day of āsāḷha; Sp 965,.17 (~āyaṃ, Se so; Be āsāḷhī-; Ce āsāḷhi-; Ee wr āsāḷhapuṇṇanāyaṃ); 1032,.32 (yāva °-puṇṇamī, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce āsāḷhīpuṇṇamā); — see also āsāḷhā, āsāḷhī̆.
āyuhapariyosāne:
āyuhapariyosāne
in Ee at Vv-a 319,.28 is prob. wr for āyupariyosāne (Be, Ce, Se so).
ṭakāra:
ṭa
m. [ts], the sound ‘ṭ’; the consonant ‘ṭ’; Sadd 604,.20 (ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa); 605,.31; —    °-kāra,    m., the letter or sound ‘ṭ’; Nidd-a I 42,.24 (visatā ti patthaṭā rūpādisu … visaṭā ti tebhūmikavyāpakavasena visaṭā, purimavacanam eva takarassa ~aṃ katvā vyañjanavisabhāgaṃ katvā vuttaṃ); —     °-vagga,    m., the retroflex consonants; Sadd 606,.12 (tatiyo ~o); 608,.30 (~-raḷakārā muddhajā).
